title: GET /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/objects/{name}: result
description: One object: its row in the list, and what its page adds. The document, the definition and the servers' states are given to a write token only.

document.description: Value. The object's stored YAML document; null for a read token, or for a proxy the platform did not write.

definition.description: Value. The document parsed into JSON, for a script that does not read YAML; null where document is null or cannot be read. Its shape is the object schema's, not this API's.

publication.description: How far the object has travelled: written, released, serving; null where the version listing has not been read.

label.description: Text. The page's word, such as Serving or Awaiting publish.

detail.description: Text. The sentence under the word.

tone.description: Code. healthy, warning, critical or unknown.

version.description: Value. The version that carries the object, such as v24; null where none does.

commit.description: Value. The commit the object was read at; null where unknown.

observed_at.description: Value. When the object was last read; null where it never was.

stale.description: Value. True where the reading is older than two polls.

server_states.description: What each node says of each server of the object; null for a read token, or where the object has none to show.

current.description: Value. False where the nodes do not run this version of the object yet, so no node's word is given.

observed_at.description: Value. When the nodes were read.

servers.description: The servers, in the order the object lists them.

pool.description: Value. The backend the server belongs to.

address.description: Value. The server's address and port.

backup.description: Value. True for a backup server.

sessions.description: Value. Sessions now open on the server; null where not reported.

nodes.description: What each node says of the server.

state.description: Code. What the node does with the server: ready, drain, maintenance, or unknown where it did not say.

lost.description: Value. True where the node was told to hold the server and has lost that setting.

check.description: Code. What the node's health check found.

label.description: Text. The page's word for the server on this node, such as UP or DRAIN. Match on state and check instead.

tone.description: Code. healthy, warning, critical or unknown.

detail.description: Text. The hover sentence under the word; null where there is none.
